AIC Fieldwork.set_page_text: 3-piece set effect: Wearer gain DMG Dealt +20% for all types of DMG, +10% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG, and Ultimate Gain Efficiency +10%.
AIC Fieldwork.text: 3-piece set effect: Wearer gains DMG Dealt +20% for all types of DMG, 10% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG, and Ultimate Gain Efficiency +10%.

AIC Heavy.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
AIC Heavy.name: AIC Heavy
AIC Heavy.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +500. 
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer restores 100 HP. Effect trigger cooldown: 5s.

AIC Light.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
AIC Light.name: AIC Light
AIC Light.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +500. 
After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer gains ATK +20 for 5s.

Aburrey's Legacy.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Aburrey's Legacy.name: Aburrey's Legacy
Aburrey's Legacy.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG +24%. 
When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 15s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

Armored MSGR.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Armored MSGR.name: Armored MSGR
Armored MSGR.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Strength +50. 
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, the wearer gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG.

Bonekrusha.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Bonekrusha.name: Bonekrusha
Bonekrusha.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +15%. 
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Bonekrushing Smash that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt +30%. Bonekrushing Smash can stack 2 time(s).

Catastrophe.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Catastrophe.name: Catastrophe
Catastrophe.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Ultimate Gain Efficiency +20%.
The wearer casts a battle skill, the action returns 50 SP. This effect only triggers 1 time per battle.

Deep Rampart.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Deep Rampart.name: Deep Rampart
Deep Rampart.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts DMG Dealt +16%.
When the wearer applies Nature Burst or Cryo Burst, the wearer gains Arts Intensity +16 for 20s. Max stacks for this effect: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s.

Eternal Xiranite.name: Eternal Xiranite
Eternal Xiranite.set_page_text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +1000.
After the wearer applies Amp, Protected, Susceptibility, or Weakened, other teammates gain DMG Dealt +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.
Eternal Xiranite.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP +1000.
After the wearer applies Amp, Protection, Susceptibility, or Weakness, other teammates gain DMG Dealt +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

Frontiers.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Frontiers.name: Frontiers
Frontiers.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%.
After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

Grizzled Edge.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Grizzled Edge.name: Grizzled Edge
Grizzled Edge.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +8%.
When the wearer applies Crush or Breach, the wearer gains Physical DMG Dealt +[6% × Max number of Vulnerability stacks consumed from one enemy] for 20s. If the target already has Physical Susceptibility, is Staggered, or has attached Originium Crystals, increase the aforementioned buff to 1.5 times. This buff cannot stack.

Hot Work.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Hot Work.name: Hot Work
Hot Work.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. 
After the wearer applies Combustion, the wearer gains Heat DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Corrosion, the wearer gains Nature DMG +50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

LYNX.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
LYNX.name: LYNX
LYNX.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency +20%. 
After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains 15% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG for 10s. If the said treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of DMG. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

MI Security.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
MI Security.name: MI Security
MI Security.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Critical Rate +5%. 
After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 5s. This effect can reach 5 stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate +5%. This effect cannot stack.

Mordvolt Insulation.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Mordvolt Insulation.name: Mordvolt Insulation
Mordvolt Insulation.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Intellect +50. 
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Arts DMG +20%.

Mordvolt Resistant.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Mordvolt Resistant.name: Mordvolt Resistant
Mordvolt Resistant.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Will +50. 
When the wearer's HP is below 50%, Treatment Effect +30%.

Pulser Labs.name: Pulser Labs
Pulser Labs.set_page_text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. 
After the wearer applies Electrification, the wearer gains Electric DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Solidification, the wearer gains Cryo DMG +50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.
Pulser Labs.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. 
After the wearer applies Electrification, the wearer gains Electric DMG+50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Solidification, the wearer gains Cryo DMG+50% for 10s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

Qingbo.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Qingbo.name: Qingbo
Qingbo.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt +20% (for every skill) for 15s. This effect can reach 2 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

Roving MSGR.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Roving MSGR.name: Roving MSGR
Roving MSGR.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Agility +50. 
When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Physical DMG +20%.

Swordmancer.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Swordmancer.name: Swordmancer
Swordmancer.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus +20%.
After the wearer applies a Physical Status, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals 250% ATK of Physical DMG and [10 Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: 15s.

Tide Surge.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Tide Surge.name: Tide Surge
Tide Surge.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt +20%.
After the wearer applies 2 or more stacks of Arts Infliction on the enemy, the wearer gains Arts DMG Dealt +35% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

Type 50 Yinglung.effect_source: set page and item pages agree
Type 50 Yinglung.name: Type 50 Yinglung
Type 50 Yinglung.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +15%. 
When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Yinglung's Edge that gives DMG +20% to the wearer's next combo skill. Yinglung's Edge can stack 3 time(s).

Xiranflow.name: Xiranflow
Xiranflow.set_page_text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +10%.
Whenever the wearer consumes Electrification or Corrosion, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the Status Level of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving Electric DMG Dealt and Nature DMG Dealt +15% for 25s. The number of buff stacks maxes out at 3 stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.
Xiranflow.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +10%.
Whenever the wearer consumes Electrification or Corrosion, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the Status Level of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving Electric DMG Dealt and Nature DMG Dealt +15% for 25s. Max number of buff stacks: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

Æthertech.name: Æthertech
Æthertech.set_page_text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +8%. 
After the wearer applies Vulnerability, the wearer gains Physical DMG +8% for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target already has 4 stack(s) of Vulnerability, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG +16% for 10s. This effect cannot stack.
Æthertech.text:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK +8%.
After the wearer applies Vulnerability, the wearer gains Physical DMG Dealt +8% for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target has 4 stacks of Vulnerability, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG Dealt +16% for 10s. This effect cannot stack.
